messages:
Alex W: Folks — Sable Therapeutics asked for a 2hr hands-on onboarding workshop to go from PoC -> Dedicated in early May. Need to lock date+facilitators.
Melanie H: nice, what's their timezone and preferred days?
Alex W: They're PST (San Francisco). They said weekdays after 11am PST work best. Prefer a weekday to include their infra and security folks.
Ravi S: I'm available M/W/F after 11. Can run the Dedicated migration section and do the live deploy demo.
Priya K: I can cover onboarding checklist, KMS/HSM ops, and handoff. Tue/Thu I have recurring customer calls though.
Melanie H: For enablement facilitation I'd prefer Wed so I can prep the workshop lab template. Wed 11:30–13:30 PST?
Alex W: Wed 11:30–13:30 PST sounds good. We should confirm with Sable first — propose 2026-05-06 or 2026-05-13 (Weds).
Priya K: 05-06 conflicts for me (internal exec sync). 05-13 works.
Ravi S: 05-13 works for me too.
Alex W: Great — @cs_bot can you create a Doodle/poll and provisional calendar event for 2026-05-13 11:30–13:30 PST, include agenda and join link? Tagging Sable AM to confirm after we draft agenda.
cs_bot: Created poll: https://doodle.example/sable-onboard-2618 and provisional calendar event: https://cal.example/event/2618000000 (organizer: Alex W).
Melanie H: Draft agenda below — please review and shorten if needed:

```
1) 11:30 - 11:40: Intros & goals (AM + CS)
2) 11:40 - 12:10: Architecture review & Dedicated sizing guidance (Ravi)
3) 12:10 - 12:35: Live deploy demo: model + config + KV cache (Ravi)
4) 12:35 - 12:55: Security & KMS integration + audit logs (Priya)
5) 12:55 - 13:15: Migration checklist, rollback plan, and SLOs (Melanie)
6) 13:15 - 13:30: Q&A + next steps + feedback capture
```

Ravi S: That looks good. Suggest we add a 5min pre-work item: share their current token distribution and typical seq lengths so we can prepare batching/quant suggestions.
Alex W: Good call — I'll ask AM to collect prework. Also let's prepare a small eval set (5 prompts) to sanity-check after deploy.
Priya K: I'll draft the prework request and the eval prompt set.
Melanie H: Logistics: can someone reserve the 'Enablement Lab' room for that time (for any in-office folks)?
Alex W: @Priya K can you book the room if needed?
Priya K: Yep, will book and attach room link to event.
Melanie H: Also recommend we create a simple feedback form for after the session — short Likert + open comment. cs_bot can you attach a Google Form to the calendar event?
cs_bot: Added placeholder feedback form: https://forms.example/sable-onboard-feedback and attached to calendar event.
Alex W: Perfect. I'll message Sable AM right now with the proposed date (2026-05-13), agenda, prework ask, and poll link.
Priya K: If Sable accepts, can we run a quick 30min dry-run with facilitators a day before? I want to check the demo infra.
Ravi S: +1 — can do 2026-05-12 09:30 PST.
Melanie H: Works for me. Add dry-run to the event and invite facilitators only.
Alex W: Will do. Thanks everyone. I'll update thread when AM confirms. :thumbsup:
